name: MITRE ATT&CK Defender - Cyber Threat Intelligence

third_party_evaluations.summary: Performance-based cert applying ATT&CK to CTI workflows.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 2, specialty: 1. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Performance-based application of ATT&CK to intelligence is a focused framework specialization; recorded recognition supports credibility, while the two-year profile does not establish wider intelligence leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The stored performance-based application of ATT&CK to intelligence workflows supports professional CTI delivery despite a two-year profile. NICCS listing and independent recognition help context but do not establish broader senior intelligence leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded performance-based application of ATT&CK to intelligence workflows provides applied evidence beyond the two-year profile. This supports professional analytical delivery within the stated framework scope.
